dict.string: NextThought uses Bluetooth only when you enable the paired native phone backup connection.
NextThought serves the optional phone companion page on your local network when you turn it on.
NextThought uses on-device speech recognition for the system audio you select.
NextThought uses your microphone for local transcription, labelled as your voice separately from system audio.
NextThought captures system audio from the selected meeting or lesson window for on-device transcription.
NextThought reads face landmarks from the camera on this Mac to tell you when your eyes leave the lens. No image is stored or sent.
NextThought captures the selected screen area or window when you request screenshot assistance.
